nodes.description: Vertically integrated majors. Anchor nodes - flows in and out across the whole graph.
US onshore E&Ps with >55% liquids mix. Permian, Bakken, Eagle Ford, DJ Basin, plus diversified.
E&Ps with >60% gas mix. Appalachia (Marcellus/Utica) and Haynesville core.
Land/mineral rights owners. No operating exposure - pure commodity price + production growth.
Floater + jackup contractors. Day-rate businesses. Tight oligopoly post-2020 restructuring.
Subsea construction, ROV, supply vessels, marine services, helicopters.
Crude/product/LPG/LNG carriers. Driven by Worldscale rates, fleet utilization, ton-mile demand.
US LNG export liquefaction + tolling. Beneficiary of HH-JKM/TTF arb.
Wellhead gas/liquids gathering, processing, NGL fractionation, gas compression. Volume-driven.
Interstate pipes, takeaway capacity, terminals. Fee-based, less commodity sensitive.
Crude → gasoline/diesel/jet. Driven by crack spreads, not flat price.
Ethane/propane → ethylene/polyethylene. NGL feedstock advantage matters.

nodes.display_name: OFS - Onshore (Pressure Pumping, Completions, Drilling Services)
nodes.description: Frac fleets, wireline, coiled tubing, sand, water. Onshore service intensity proxy.
Drill bits, BOPs, wellheads, capital equipment. Long-cycle vs OFS short-cycle.
Corn ethanol, RNG, biodiesel. Driven by RIN credits and corn-ethanol spread, not crude.
Thermal + metallurgical coal producers. Feeds power generation and steelmaking.
Unregulated power generation. AI/data center demand re-rating in progress.
Regulated electrics with significant gas-fired or nuclear generation. Pass-through fuel cost.
Pure-play natural gas local distribution companies. NG1-indirect via fuel cost pass-through.
Wind, solar, hydro, storage, geothermal operators. PPA-backed cash flows.
Front-end of nuclear fuel cycle: mining, enrichment, conversion.
Pre-revenue / early-revenue advanced reactor designers. Pure thesis play on AI-nuclear.
Gas stations + convenience. Volume + merchandise margin business.
